prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: side impact at intersection in Conroe, Texas. Injury: concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1148; do not mention it.)
text: I was driving north on the main road and approached the intersection on a green light. As I entered the crossing, a vehicle coming from the cross street did not stop and struck the driver's side of my car. The impact spun my vehicle partially around and pushed it onto the shoulder. My airbags deployed, and I struck my head against the window frame. I was dazed and had a severe headache, nausea, and trouble focusing my eyes. Paramedics arrived on scene and transported me to the hospital, where I was diagnosed with a concussion and advised to rest and avoid screens for several days. I have not been able to return to work since the accident. I believe the other driver failed to yield the right of way, and I am providing this statement so that my claim can be reviewed.
